token.description: Token authenticates over HTTPS with a token read from Token.Env.

ssh.description: SSH authenticates over SSH with a private key read from SSH.Env.

insecure_skip_host_key_verification.description:
InsecureSkipHostKeyVerification disables SSH host key verification,
removing protection against man-in-the-middle attacks. Only intended
for ephemeral environments (e.g. CI) where maintaining a known_hosts
file is impractical. Has no effect on token (HTTPS) authentication.

existing.AuthConfig.description: AuthConfig selects exactly one authentication method.

url.description:
URL is the remote repository URL (ssh or https).
Examples: "git@github.com:org/repo.git", "https://github.com/org/repo.git".

branch.description: Branch is the git branch to use (default: "main").

path.description:
Path is an optional subdirectory within the repository. When set, all
operations are scoped to this path.

auth.description:
Auth specifies the credentials NIC uses to push to the repository
(requires write access).

argocd_auth.description:
ArgoCDAuth specifies optional separate credentials for ArgoCD's in-cluster
read access. When unset, Auth is used.

existing.Config.description: Config holds the configuration for the existing repository provider.

existing.EnvRef.description: EnvRef names the environment variable a secret is read from.
